commitments.description: Reduce virgin petroleum plastic in packaging by 50% by 2030.

controversies.description: Pampers and similar single-use diapers contribute large volumes of non-recyclable plastic to landfills worldwide.

wooby.headline: P&G makes diapers, shampoo, and Tide pods — almost all in plastic.
wooby.narrative: P&G makes Pampers, Tide, Pantene, and Gillette. Wooby has noticed shampoo bottles drift in the surf. P&G is testing refillable shampoo bottles in some shops.
